videos.opening_activity: preparing a rolling repair cart for a job and checking its labeled tool slots
paring down a cosmetics-counter purchase by setting aside a larger luxury item while keeping one small lipstick
quality-checking apples on a moving sorting table and accidentally sending an obviously bruised apple into the good crate while discarding a clean one
sorting small stage-maintenance tools into a compartmented case after a rehearsal has ended, while unconsciously repeating the same three-tool placement rhythm
videos.opening_location: empty neighborhood music rehearsal studio during post-session cleanup

videos.opening_activity: coiling a salt-wet mooring line after securing a small docked skiff, then stopping when one section has cinched itself into an unusually tangled knot
videos.opening_location: weathered public marina dock beside a small tied skiff

videos.opening_activity: sorting mismatched hand tools back onto a wall-mounted tool rack after a community repair session while another volunteer works at the neighboring bench
boring a pilot hole into a wooden display base with an old hand-cranked geared drill, then stopping when its exposed interlocking gears bind mid-turn
videos.opening_location: quiet maritime museum exhibit-preparation room beside an unfinished shipwreck display

videos.opening_activity: checking a dripping irrigation junction at a city allotment, then pausing as a nearby garden hose continues spraying unattended across an empty plot
videos.opening_location: quiet early-morning urban community garden with several adjacent raised beds

videos.opening_activity: tying a sagging tomato vine back onto its trellis with her long fingers as the greenhouse's timed overhead misters suddenly activate across the surrounding beds without anyone operating them
videos.opening_location: rooftop greenhouse garden above a quiet high-rise district at early morning

videos.opening_activity: deliberately comparing public display with private concealment
videos.opening_location: quiet sculpture gallery beside a temporary changing booth

opening_signature.prop_family: nude marble statue and privacy curtain
opening_signature.reveal_family: same body category, different social rule

videos.situation_summary: A nude marble figure is openly displayed while a nearby person urgently pulls a changing curtain shut.
videos.hook_line: Why can a naked statue feel proper when a naked person feels exposed?

videos.opening_activity: comparing secure food and water supplies with sudden storm damage to the camp
videos.opening_location: small camp on an uninhabited tropical beach after a storm

opening_signature.prop_family: full rain barrel and torn shelter
opening_signature.reveal_family: a secure camp can still be disrupted

videos.situation_summary: A full rain barrel and fresh food sit beside a shelter ripped apart by a storm.
videos.hook_line: If the island has food and water, why can't you stay forever?

videos.opening_activity: testing whether abundant food also provides enough dietary variety for long-term survival
videos.opening_location: a simple island food shelter beside coconut trees

opening_signature.prop_family: fish rack, coconuts and meal plate
opening_signature.reveal_family: repeated meals expose a long-term nutrition gap

videos.situation_summary: The camp has lots to eat, but nearly every meal comes from the same two foods.
videos.hook_line: If food is everywhere, why can the same few meals still fail you?

videos.opening_activity: Comparing how trapped air and water respond when exposed to the same increased pressure.

opening_signature.reveal_family: pressure affects gas far more than water-rich tissue

videos.situation_summary: Inside one pressure chamber, an air-filled bulb shrinks while a water-filled bulb beside it barely changes.
videos.hook_line: If water crushes air pockets, why not your whole body?

videos.opening_activity: testing a surprising change in a familiar animal's needs by observing how a fish behaves outside water
videos.opening_location: a quiet coastal research garden with a small pool and damp plant-filled ground

opening_signature.reveal_family: one change is not every change

videos.situation_summary: A fish is active beside water instead of fully inside it.
videos.hook_line: If fish could breathe on land, why would they still need water?

videos.opening_activity: Comparing how reduced weight affects a person's effort and the way a bridge model carries loads.
videos.opening_location: Open engineering display area with a simple bridge model and demonstration objects.
videos.situation_summary: A person carries a heavy object easily, but a bridge model bends differently.
videos.hook_line: If your weight was cut in half, would Earth feel the same?

videos.opening_activity: Comparing how flexible and rigid body structures respond to the same bending force.
videos.opening_location: A quiet engineering display room with simple material demonstration models.
videos.situation_summary: A metal frame holds weight well but cannot move like a living body.
videos.hook_line: If bones were metal, would your body become stronger?

videos.opening_activity: Testing how scaling weight without widening bone thickness breaks upright support.
videos.opening_location: Outdoor comparative biomechanics pavilion beside life-size animal leg casts.

opening_signature.prop_family: scaled leg bone model and weighted torso block
opening_signature.reveal_family: bone area falls behind total volume growth

videos.situation_summary: Weight grows with volume, but bone strength only grows with cross-section area.
videos.hook_line: If you grew as big as an elephant, could your legs still hold your weight?

videos.opening_activity: Comparing warmth loss between scaled body shapes using matching body models and heat demonstrations.
videos.opening_location: A quiet science display hall with body models and simple heat comparison exhibits.
videos.situation_summary: Two body models lose warmth at different speeds.
videos.hook_line: If a human grew huge, would their body cool the same?
